einzeiler: Listeners share personal stories about secret hard drives, fantasy plot lines, and porn.
kurzfassung: Listeners share personal stories about consuming, hiding, and quitting pornography. The episode explores how digital habits intersect with private fantasies, shame, and relationships. It highlights the complex emotional weight attached to individual viewing practices.
stichpunkte: Listeners share anonymous stories about discovering, using, and hiding pornography.
A listener named James describes trying to resist porn cravings while his wife is away.
Rose explains how finding porn on Tumblr during a heartbreak shaped her viewing habits.
Antonio discusses relying on gay porn and how his fantasies compare to real-life relationships.
Martin recounts being extorted for thousands of dollars after illegally downloading porn.
Michael describes maintaining a highly curated collection on a secret hard drive as self-care.
Daniel shares how obsessive-compulsive disorder and intrusive thoughts complicate his relationship with porn.
James explains how web-monitoring software and an ultimatum from his wife helped him stay clean.
